headline: Netflix (NFLX) Replaces Bela Bajaria With Peter Rice As Content Chief
summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX) has replaced chief content officer Bela Bajaria with former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice. The leadership change coincides with Netflix undertaking its largest workforce reduction to date across global operations. Rice previously oversaw a broad slate of scripted and unscripted hits spanning broadcast TV, cable networks, and streaming platforms.
